unsupported: A PDF statement uploaded directly to a lender is not governed by the Account Aggregator consent framework; the Master Direction only applies when sharing happens through an AA with a consent artefact.

I can tell you that a statement by itself carries no password or OTP, so it does not by itself enable a debit—but I cannot tell you whether your account is at risk, because that depends on what else may have been shared and what the lender's controls are.
